name: Filthy Rich
source:
Your brother's best friend, a freshly minted billionaire, returns to LA with an offer you can't refuse. Ready to mix business and pleasure?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Filthy_Rich]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你哥哥最好的朋友，一位新晋亿万富翁，带着你无法拒绝的提议回到洛杉矶。准备好兼顾商务与休闲了吗？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Filthy_Rich]Choices Wikia[/url]]
